name: portside-pirate-ability-does-not-rest-the-pirate
notes: Portside Pirate: banish a floating-memory card from the graveyard to give the Pirate a buff counter and stealth. The ability used to exhaust the Pirate (implicit REST) although its cost has no [REST].

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Portside Pirate's activated ability has no [REST] in its printed cost, but DoActivatedAbility() rests every ally/champion/phantasia that uses an activated ability unless its id is on the skipAutoRest list, so using the ability exhausted the card. Fix: the id is on the skipAutoRest list.
